description: Your key's jobs, newest first, 20 per page (limit 1-100). Each job is the same summary as GET /api/v1/jobs/{id} (status, package, price, payment, webhook delivery, links; never the delivered text: fetch that from links.result). next_cursor is null on the last page. Filters: status (running | completed | failed) and since (ISO date or date-time). Bad values get a 400 (bad_limit, bad_cursor, bad_status, bad_since). Covers the key's newest 2,000 jobs. Read-only and free. The same as GET /api/v1/jobs.

api_key.description: Your Roster API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

cursor.description: Opaque: pass next_cursor from the previous page to get the next one (with the same status and since).

limit.description: How many jobs per page, 1 to 100 (default 20).

since.description: Only jobs created at or after this time: an ISO 8601 date-time with a zone (2026-10-28T09:00:00Z, 2026-10-28T05:00:00-04:00) or a date (2026-10-28, meaning midnight America/New_York).

status.description: Only jobs with this status: running, completed, failed.

name: list_jobs
title: List jobs
